outcome.Summary: Created package `tmpl` (tmpl/tmpl.go + tmpl/tmpl_test.go, stdlib only). Render parses `{{ ... }}` tags with `{{{{` as a literal `{{`, resolves dotted names through nested map[string]any values (missing → empty string; indexing a non-map is an error containing the full dotted name), formats values per spec, and applies the upper/lower/trim/default/truncate/html filters left-to-right with double-quoted, escape-aware arguments. Errors (unknown filter, missing/extra argument, bad truncate arg, unterminated/empty tag, bad name) return a descriptive error and empty output. Added ~60 table-driven test cases covering all formatting rules, escapes, nested lookup, and every error class; verified with `go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1` (exit 0) and gofmt.
